QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: enabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Show the vision recognition button in the Fly View tool strip.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: serverUrl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Base URL of the local vision recognition service (GET /health, POST /analyze).

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: serverCommand
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Command line used to start the vision service. Empty: use the command registered by the model installer (HKCU\Software\QGC-Vision\ServerCommand).

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: autoStartServer
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Start the vision service when QGC starts (if it is not already running) and stop it when QGC exits.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: captureSeconds
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: How many seconds of video frames to send for one recognition.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: captureFps
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Frames per second taken from the video during capture.
